definitions.explanation: Outdoor leisure activities such as camping, hiking, and fishing. Also used as a modifier to describe products or lifestyles oriented toward outdoor recreation.

examples.japanese: アウトドアが{好|す}きだ。
{週末|しゅうまつ}はアウトドアを{楽|たの}しむことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: I often enjoy outdoor activities on weekends.

examples.japanese: アウトドア{用品|ようひん}を{揃|そろ}えて、{家族|かぞく}でキャンプに{行|い}く{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: We plan to get outdoor gear together and go camping as a family.

notes:
アウトドア comes from English "outdoor" and refers to outdoor recreational activities like camping, hiking, and fishing. It is used both as a standalone noun and as a modifier.

USAGE:
- As a noun: アウトドアが{好|す}き (I like outdoor activities)
- As a modifier: アウトドア{用品|ようひん} (outdoor gear)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アウトドア{用品|ようひん}: outdoor gear/equipment
- アウトドア{派|は}: outdoor type (person who prefers outdoor activities)
- アウトドア{活動|かつどう}: outdoor activities
- アウトドアブランド: outdoor brand
- アウトドアライフ: outdoor lifestyle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- インドア: indoor activities/type — アウトドア{派|は} vs. インドア{派|は} is a common way to describe lifestyle preferences
